environment.description: Same plugin deployed via Helm chart with pod spec override: securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true at container level, no emptyDir or tmpfs volume mounts defined, /tmp is part of the read-only overlay. The container uses a distroless base image (gcr.io/distroless/java17-debian11) which has no shell binaries (/bin/sh, /bin/bash, etc. are absent). The pod runs with a Kubernetes SecurityContext that sets runAsNonRoot=true, runAsUser=65534, and drops ALL capabilities. No writable volume is mounted at any path including /var/lib/pipeline/cache, /tmp, /dev/shm, or /proc/self. The OCI runtime spec has a seccomp profile that blocks execve, execveat, and fork syscalls (based on RuntimeDefault with additional deny list). Note: the Java ObjectInputStream deserialization still occurs and the gadget chain fires, but the final payload (Runtime.exec or ProcessBuilder) fails because (1) no writable filesystem location exists to drop payloads, (2) no shell binary exists in the image, (3) execve/execveat syscalls are blocked by seccomp even if a binary path were somehow resolved, and (4) fork is blocked preventing any child process creation.
